{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in the 'arm' column again, ensuring case consistency
print('Unique arms:', df['arm'].unique())

# Inspect the actual values in the 'arm' column more carefully
print('\nValue counts for arm column:\n', df['arm'].value_counts())

# Now filter for the TREATMENT arm — using exact string match
# Note: the data shows 'treatment' in lowercase
filtered_df = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check the size of the filtered dataframe
print(f'Number of patients in treatment arm: {len(filtered_df)}')

# Check how many responded in the treatment arm
responded_count = filtered_df['responded'].sum()
print(f'Number of responders in treatment arm: {responded_count}')

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_responded = responded_count / len(filtered_df)
print(f'Fraction responded in treatment arm: {fraction_responded}')"}
